name: Decode State
func:
const value = msg.payload.data[0];

msg.payload = {
    value: value,
    enable_delayed_uvp: Boolean(value & 1 << 0),
    uvp_delay_ls_hs_switch: Boolean(value & 1 << 1),
    enable_cv_mode_after_cc_cp: Boolean(value & 1 << 2),
    cc_cv_switch: Boolean(value & 1 << 3),
    cp_cc_switch: Boolean(value & 1 << 4),
    enable_dcdc_mode: Boolean(value & 1 << 6),
    enable_hs_balancing: Boolean(value & 1 << 8),
    enable_mppt_filtering: Boolean(value & 1 << 9),
    dcdc_cv_ls_hs_switch: Boolean(value & 1 << 10),
    enable_bidi_dcdc_voltage_control_current: Boolean(value & 1 << 11),
    enable_mppt_boost_charging: Boolean(value & 1 << 12),
    dcdc_mode: Boolean(value & 1 << 13),
    mppt_mode: Boolean(value & 1 << 15)
}

return msg;

# Energy Hub

## Multi-Input, Multi-Output Energy Flow Routing

## Software Application Example

## Controller
* Manual or Automated Control
* Async Web Interface built using the Node-RED-Dashboard-2.0 (Vue App) compoment by FlowFuse.

## Compatible HW
* Linux SBC Controller (Raspberry Pi 5 or Compatible)
* Isolated CAN-2.0 (EF) Hardware as GPIO Extension
* Isolated RS-485 (Modbus RTU) Interface as GPIO Extension
* Open-Source Hardware Remote Sensors

## Compatible Power Input and Output Modules
* Medium-Voltage DC BMS: 120 V and 180V, 30 kW (Emus BMS)
* High-Voltage DCDC 50 kW
* Line AC, Three-Phase, 260 ... 530 V (Infypower REG50050)
